search_boundary: Bounded Sunday PubMed review of one newly indexed multinational HARMONi phase 3 record, its linked correction metadata, and the existing HARMONi-A comparison record. No full-text reanalysis, hospital data or patient-specific inference.

sources_checked.finding: September 2026 multinational randomized phase 3 HARMONi trial record; publication predates retrieval and is classified as newly discovered historical evidence.
The parent record links an October 2026 correction; the correction's substantive content was not available in the bounded review.
Existing HARMONi-A baseline record retained; the new record is a distinct multinational study and does not overwrite it.

human_gate_reason: New peer-reviewed clinical evidence and its linked correction require bounded medical interpretation before any accepted-state change; no individual prognosis or treatment recommendation is authorized.
